FAQ

Everything people ask about this site, including the questions where the honest answer is “not yet.”

Who runs this site?

Seniors in the Waukegan High School Class of 2027. A small site team handles content, photos, and moderation. Nobody is paid and nobody is a professional, which is why we double-check everything against the school.

Is this the official WHS website?

No. This is a student-run site and is not operated by WHS or Waukegan CUSD 60. The official school site is whs.wps60.org and the district is at wps60.org. For anything binding, such as transcripts, fees, eligibility, or discipline, go there.

How do you know the dates are right?

Every school date on this site comes from the District 60 calendar or the WHS website. Dates we could not confirm are labelled Tentative or Awaiting school update rather than filled in with a guess. If the school has not published something, the page says so in plain words.

Why does the graduation page not have a date?

Because WHS has not published one yet. The moment it appears on an official source, the graduation page and home page switch to a live count. Until then, the last day of classes is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

How do photos get approved?

Anyone can submit a photo. It sits in a private queue until a photographer or moderator on the site team looks at it. School-appropriate photos that show the class in a good light get approved and appear on the photos page with your credit. Rejected ones are deleted.

I am in a photo and I want it taken down.

Use the contact form and pick “Photo removal request.” Describe the photo well enough for us to find it. You do not have to give a reason, and the photo comes down before any questions are asked.

Something on the site is wrong. How do I fix it?

Send a correction with the page, what it says, and what it should say. We check against the school and fix it. Corrections and removals are handled before anything else.

What do you do with my email when I fill out a form?

Only what the form says. Emails on submissions are used to reply or verify a request and are never shown publicly. The privacy page lists everything the site collects, which is not much.

Is the site accessible?

That is the goal. Every image has alt text, every control works from the keyboard, focus is visible, and motion respects your system’s reduced-motion setting. If something gets in your way, tell us on the accessibility page.

Is there a dark mode?

Yes. The moon-and-sun button in the top bar switches it. The site follows your device setting until you pick one, and remembers your pick on this device only.

Can I get updates by email?

You can sign up on the news page and choose which kinds of updates you want. Honest note: emails begin when notifications launch. Until then it is a list, and only the site team can see it.

How do I join the team?

Contact us and say what you like doing: writing, photography, design, moderating, or just being organized. Seniors only, no experience required, and yes it counts as something to put on an application.

Not answered here? The site team reads everything.
